name: I go discipline you
description: Side-eye blob caption 'I go discipline you'. Nigerian uncle/aunty tease: playful scold, not real punishment.
whenToUse: When someone is being a rascal, late, talking big, repeating nonsense, or needs a fond scold: 'I go flog you', 'you this child', 'mind yourself'. Banter after a silly mistake. Keep it affectionate.
whenNotToUse: Not for real discipline, abuse, kids in trouble, anger, or serious correction. Skip if the user is upset or asking for help.
